name: EPIC 249488609
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 13.9 solar radii and 1.72 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,710 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.72 solar masses and 13.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,277 K at its surface.
